title: 🐶 DOG DID DOG
description: We’re building a tight-knit community of friends, not just a gaming space. Whether you’re a master builder, a redstone engineer, or an explorer, there’s a place for you here
body:
We’re building a tight-knit community of friends, not just a gaming space. Whether you’re a master builder, a redstone engineer, or an explorer, there’s a place for you here

![](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/2PD4CG9Y/images/90c3b84f78c7cd665cf77633587d191853a171fb.png)

**IMPORTANT:** before you join the game, we need to add you to the whitelist after you join our discord server!

**The Vibe:**
- True Semi-Vanilla: We use mods to enhance variety (new biomes, structures, and mechanics) without losing that classic Minecraft "soul."
- Creative Freedom: Build cities, explore the unknown, or automate the world.
- Long-term Focused: We aren't here for a "reset every month." We’re here to build history.

**Our Current Roadmap:**

🎯 Reach 20+ active members (we’re halfway there!).

🏛️ Establish 2+ independent, player-run cities.

🎭 Develop deep, player-driven lore.

🎉 Host our first massive server-wide event.

**The Backstory:** It started as a simple local world between two friends. As the world grew, we realized it was too big to keep to ourselves. We moved to a dedicated server so the world stays alive 24/7, even when we’re offline.
